scope: architecture only: the institutional footprint's atlas, point-in-time discipline, latent states, cells, coverage and wiring are correct and connected. It is never evidence that any footprint cell carries alpha.
source: backlog row 2026-09-30 'architectural acceptance directive'; footprint PRs #159 and #237
evaluation_rule: every row names an evaluator in desks/mt5/research/institutional_acceptance.py that reads the repository and the footprint's artifacts: a violation is FAIL, an absent, unreadable or stale (>26h) artifact is UNMEASURED, and only PASS lets the row reach CURRENT_VERIFIED (with its files, fresh runtime proof and no open blocker)

requirements.title: atlas: every row institutional.<jur>.<publisher>.<dataset> (or a first-registering lane's id carrying atlas_id/aliases), with a declared status, and a pit_note on every frame-producing row (exactly 'UNMEASURED: release timing not established' where the repo cannot time it); no duplicate ids
requirements.clock: hourly_cycle:institutional_footprint (CORE_LEGS); audited hourly by global_research_os -> global_research_acceptance

blockers.why: the footprint (atlas, ontology, engine, leg, rulings, pack field) exists only on claude/institutional-footprint and claude/footprint-followups; LIVE (claude/llm-auto-upgrade-verify-gcjac3) carries none of it until #159/#237 merge, so the box never runs it
